archived.body: First Light Particles is a calm, atmospheric piano piece designed for story-driven games, exploration scenes, dream sequences, and emotional cutscenes. It features: •soft shimmering piano •subtle low-frequency pulses •transparent blue-tone harmony •slow emotional movement •no groove, no percussion •gentle ambient pads drifting like early morning light The mood is peaceful, introspective, and slightly cosmic, suitable for: •VN / visual novels •indie RPGs •space exploration •atmospheric platformers •menu / title screen •meditation / quiet areas •“first morning light”, “awakening”, “memories resurfacing” scenes This track is CC0 (public domain) — free to use in any project, no attribution required (though appreciated).

archived.body: 3 recordings of ambience in different parts of a public park. One is close to a copse of trees, featuring birds chattering before the rain. The second is a recording of a small river with water falling over a low step, with some bird calls and frogs and other wildlife. The third is recorded in an open field with more intense wind. All recordings were made in a public park in Adelaide, South Australia, in winter. All files are recorded at 48kHz. To keep the filesize under 100mb, the two largest recordings have a bit depth of 16 bit. The park_ambience_wind file has a bit depth of 24 bit.

archived.body: This pack was put together by browsing my computer's music folder, rendering out any song I haven't released before so that it loops, and putting it in a folder! If that's not quality sound design then I don't know what is! I guess these songs were all made in the last 3-ish years for various projects that got cancelled, or they're from a night of messing around. Therefor, the style and feel of the songs is all over the place... BUT THAT'S COOL! All these songs are licensed under: CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0) Public Domain Dedication That means you can use 'em for whatever, whenever! No need to ask for permission or even credit me! (Although I'd be happy if you did) Have a lovely afternoon!
